request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From Babylon we walk away
Following Zerubbabel's call
Ninety-eight of Ater's line
From Hezekiah we stand tall

[Chorus]
Ninety-eight souls come home
To the gate where we belong
Guarding the temple door
The covenant seal is strong

[Verse]
Among the gatekeepers we stand
Shallum and Ater side by side
Talmon and Akkub keep watch
Hatita and Shobai abide

[Chorus]
Ninety-eight souls come home
To the gate where we belong
Guarding the temple door
The covenant seal is strong

[Bridge]
Adonijah and Bigvai sign
Adin joins the holy line
We pledge to follow God's law
In this restored and sacred place

[Outro]
Ninety-eight names in the list
Faithful in the quiet dust
